items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping already dry, flaky-looking skin.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to comfort dry-looking skin and support the look of a healthy moisture barrier.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides gives daily sun protection and blends well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I left out the glycolic toner and vitamin C serum because strong exfoliating acids and high-strength actives can be too harsh on skin while you are on isotretinoin, so please check with your prescriber or a dermatologist before adding any actives. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF each morning as the last step.
